people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
translations.bsb: “I myself cannot do it,” Joseph replied, “but God will give Pharaoh a sound answer.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
translations.asv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
